= nested-font-subs(1)
:doctype: manpage
:manmanual: PDF font checks
:mansource: acdc
:revdate: 2026-10-05
:styled: pass:q[*AttributeBold _AttributeBoth_*]

== Name
nested-font-subs - combined styles with substitutions

== Description

`Before {styled} after`.

[source,text,subs="+quotes"]
----
CodePlain *CodeBold _CodeBoth_ CodeTail* CodeEnd.
CodePlain _CodeItalic *CodeReverse* ItalicTail_ CodeEnd.
----

[subs="-quotes"]
Literal `Mono *Bold _Italic_*`.

[source,text]
----
Literal *Bold _Italic_*.
----
